leader_line — ANNOTATE pointer op

• Data kinds: image2d × text → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.leader_line(img, anchor_xy, target_xy, text=None, color='emphasis', width=2, cap='dot', cap_size=4, elbow=True, scheme='okabe_ito', style=None, **text_kw) (to call the implementation directly, import annotate; annotate.leader_line(img, anchor_xy, target_xy, text=None, color='emphasis', width=2, cap='dot', cap_size=4, elbow=True, scheme='okabe_ito', style=None, **text_kw); from the registry, opsannotate.get("leader_line"))

Usage

A leader line — from the note's position (anchor_xy) to its target (target_xy).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

elbow=True なら水平 → 斜めの 2 折れで引く(注記が本体に被りにくい)。端点には cap の印('dot'/'arrow'/'cross'/'none')を置く。text を渡すと anchor_xy 側に text_box を置く。追加の **text_kw は text_box へそのまま渡す。

Raises

ValueError

未知の cap、非有限な座標、線が画像の外。
